name: The Yeatman
insider_take: This luxury wine hotel sits majestically across the Douro River from Porto's UNESCO World Heritage center, offering unparalleled views of the city's iconic terracotta rooftops and legendary port wine cellars below.
whats_special: The Yeatman is Portugal's first luxury wine hotel, featuring the world's largest collection of Portuguese wines with over 25,000 bottles. Each room is uniquely themed around different Portuguese wine regions and decorated with artwork from renowned Portuguese artists. The hotel's two-Michelin-starred restaurant showcases exceptional wine pairings with panoramic city views.
pro_tip: Book the Taylor Fladgate suite for exclusive access to a private wine cellar, and time your visit during sunset for the most spectacular views of Porto's illuminated Ribeira district reflected in the Douro River.
dont_miss: The hotel's caudalie spa treatments using grape-based therapies, private port wine tastings in historic Vila Nova de Gaia cellars just steps away, and the infinity pool that creates the illusion of floating above Porto's skyline. The nearby Dom Luís I Bridge offers perfect photo opportunities of both the hotel and the city.
pros: Stunning panoramic views of Porto and Douro River
World-class wine cellar and port wine collection
Luxury spa with indoor pool and wine therapy treatments
cons: Located on hillside requiring transportation to city center
